title: Joiner request for Rotterdam implementation analyst

sections.heading: Request
paragraphs: Ticket HRQ-418. Rosa van Dijk joins the Customer Enablement team on 12 October. The manager requested a managed laptop, a corporate mailbox, the support knowledge base, and a seat in the Wayline demo tenant.

sections.heading: Decision
paragraphs: Approve standard employee access and customer sandbox access. The manager will submit a separate, time-limited request if production tenant access becomes necessary.

sections.heading: Handoff
paragraphs: IT will hand over the laptop in Rotterdam at 09:30 local time. Buddy Marta de Vries will run the demo tenant walkthrough and confirm account setup by the end of day one.
